title: Signal: MD5 use via Insecure.MD5.hash (swift) — review required
scope: Single-line lexical match on the Insecure.MD5.hash call in swift code.
limitations: Lexical, line-based: matches any Insecure.MD5.hash call regardless of purpose. Bare md5() calls belong to the generic rule; other weak algorithms are separate rules.
fpNotes: Deduplication, etag, and cache-key checksums are the common false positives; they need only a justifying comment.
